name: adapt_moved_file_ruby_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the file the agent's first solution requires is RENAMED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old file deleted, new one created); the agent must update its require_relative, not keep pointing at the old filename
prompts: pricing_rules.rb defines a constant DISCOUNT. Create checkout.rb with `require_relative "pricing_rules"` and a method apply_discount(price) that returns price * (1 - DISCOUNT).
pricing_rules.rb has been renamed to config_rules.rb (same DISCOUNT value). Update checkout.rb's require_relative to "config_rules" - do not keep requiring the old filename.

test_setup_files.checkout_hidden_test.rb:
require_relative "checkout"

got = apply_discount(100)
raise "apply_discount(100) = #{got}" if (got - 90).abs > 1e-9
puts "all tests passed"

reference_solution.checkout.rb:
require_relative "config_rules"

def apply_discount(price)
  price * (1 - DISCOUNT)
end

files.checkout.rb:
require_relative "pricing_rules"

def apply_discount(price)
  price * (1 - DISCOUNT)
end
